jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is a flawed eye-only game sprite. Redraw one matching PAIR of handsome adult Chinese male cultivator eyes, strict frontal view, gaze directly at viewer, serene intelligent clear expression. Fix its ruler-straight heavy upper lids, spiky eyeliner wings, overoutlined lower lids and sleepy flat irises. Natural gently curved upper eyelids, softly rising short outer corners; clear warm gray-brown iris with upper fifth naturally hidden by upper lid, round pupil centered, no upward staring or squint. Eye opening should look comfortably alert, not enormous. Very fine interrupted lower lid ink stroke, almost no lower lashes, no heavy lower eye shadow. Realistic Chinese ink-and-light-watercolor portrait rendering, delicate warm brown ink edges, subtle paper pigment grain; matte warm ivory sclera, small symmetric muted catchlights. Keep male character. Canvas 1536x1024 transparent. Place left iris center approximately (480,510), right iris center (1056,510), left eye from x300 to640, right from896 to1236; natural eye opening about90px high. NO eyebrows, nose, skin slab, eyelid skin patches, face or hair. Only eye whites/irises/pupils/lid lines/lashes with clean semitransparent ink edges. No background or glow. Preserve pair as one asset, balanced bilateral anatomy; redraw features rather than vertically stretching the input.
